description: 3-layer hand-built char transformer: look-back heads build word vectors, exact/hypernym match of hyp words to premise, conflict-category head, cue lexicons; counts -> logits.
v1 + stemming layer (strip -s/-ing before premise matching) and extra conflict categories (day/night, old/young, vehicles, sports, instruments, ...).
v2 + prepositions/auxiliaries as stopwords and more synonym/hypernym classes (wearing<-clothes, look/watch, talk, photo, hold/carry, perform, eat, ...).
v3 + -ed stemming and a final-MLP 'no overlap' feature relu(U - 2*matchedContent) pushing toward contradiction when the hypothesis describes a different scene.
v4 + larger hand-written hypothesis cue lexicons (neutral: family/goal/emotion words; entailment: 'at least', instrument; contradiction: frowning).
